STATE LEVEL POLICE RECRUITMENT BOARD, ASSAM
ADVERTISEMENT
Advertisement for 127 posts of Driver Constable in Assam Police and
4 posts of Driver Operator in Fire & Emergency Services in the Pay Scale of Rs. 14000 -70000/-.
Online Applications will be received with effect from 16-12-2025 to 16-01-2026.
3.1 There will be no Application Fee.

5. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
5.1 Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam.
5.2 The Applicant must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam.
5.3 The Applicant must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently.
5.5 Age:
5.5.A For the post of Driver Constable in Assam Police : The age of the Applicant must be 18-25 as on
01-01-2026.
5.5.B For the post of Driver Operator in F & ES: The age of the Applicant must be 20-30 years as on
01 -01-2026.
5.5.C Relaxations : Upper age limit for different categories are as under:
1 SC, ST (P) and ST (H) 5 years
2 OBC/MOBC 3 years
Page 2 of 4
5.6 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION & OTHER MANDATORY REQUIREMENT:
5.6.A HSLC or equivalent examination passed from a recognized
Board or Council.
5.6.B For the post of Driver Constable in Assam Police, Applicant must possess valid driving license for LMV or MMV or HMV.
5.6.C For the post of Driver Operator in F & ES, Applicant must possess valid driving license for HMV.
5.7 PHYSICAL STANDARDS:
5.7.A Height:
Male General 162.5 cm
5.7.B Chest (Only for men):
Normal 80 cm Expanded 85 cm
5.8 MEDICAL STANDARDS:
Applicants must be in good mental and bodily health and free from colour blindness.
Male General 162.5 cm
Normal 80 cm Expanded 85 cm
6. HOW TO APPLY:
1. Register on the SLPRB portal.
2. Upload the required documents and submit the application.
6.1 DOCUMENTS TO BE UPLOADED:
(i) Passport size photograph and signature.
(ii) HSLC certificate and
valid driving licence.
Page 3 of 4
7. PHASES OF RECRUITMENT TESTS
(i) Physical Standard Test
(ii) Physical Efficiency Test
(iii) Written Test
(iv) Driving Skill Test
(v) Medical Examination
7.9 WRITTEN TEST:
The test will consist of 100 multiple choice type questions on an OMR answer sheet.
Total marks for the Written Test will be 50. There will be no negative marking.
The subjects to be covered will be:
(i) Elementary Arithmetic
(ii) General English
(iii) Logical reasoning
7.10 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
Candidates must produce original documents during verification.
